column1: # Publishes the per-orthogroup Leonid table (+ validation report). Source globs
# are relative to this manifest's directory (the workflow-RUN_* root).
# Build with (from the integrator subproject root):
# This is a COPYME template (single source of truth). The discovery helper
# ignores manifests in workflow-COPYME-* dirs; copy this file into the canonical
# workflow-RUN_* dir for it to publish (per gigantic_conventions §38/§39).

column6: One row per OrthoHMM orthogroup: Orthogroup_ID, comma-delimited member sequence IDs, member count, singleton flag, then TWO columns each for Pfam/GO/PANTHER identifiers and names, Annogroups_Pfam/GO/PANTHER identifiers and names, Gene_Families identifiers and names, and Gene_Groups identifiers and names (' // '-delimited names aligned to identifiers). Filename includes a run timestamp suffix _monthdd_hhmm. Species-tree deconvolution — one column per non-redundant clade/species across structures 001, 003, 031, 032 giving the count of member sequences within that clade (each header records which of the four structures the clade appears in).

Fail-fast validation cross-checks (row count vs input orthogroups, member-count vs sequence-ID count, singleton flag, deconvolution completeness where the species columns sum to the member count and root clades equal it, and accession/name alignment). Status PASS means every cross-check held.
